tasks.title: Review agent fabric and protocol contracts
tasks.objective: Inspect the existing agent fabric/protocol implementation and tests. Identify correctness, lifecycle, idempotency, and failure-contract gaps. Implement only narrow, evidence-backed fixes and add regression tests. Do not duplicate the existing swarm engine or invent live-agent execution.
acceptance_criteria: Existing agent fabric and protocol behavior is inspected before changes are proposed.
Any behavior change has a focused regression test.
No secrets, external provider calls, production resources, or unrelated files are touched.
The result reports exact test commands and outcomes, or explicitly marks tests not_run/blocked.

tasks.title: Review approval and endpoint security boundaries
tasks.objective: Inspect approval_service and endpoint_security implementations and their tests. Look for authorization bypasses, approval replay, unsafe request parsing, scope escalation, and fail-open behavior. Make only narrowly scoped fixes supported by regression tests. Do not weaken controls to make tests pass.
acceptance_criteria: Security-sensitive logic and existing tests are reviewed before editing.
Any identified exploitable defect has a minimal regression test and fail-closed fix.
No credentials, network calls, account settings, or deployment resources are accessed.
Unconfirmed findings are reported as risks rather than presented as proven vulnerabilities.

tasks.title: Review continuity store and MCP memory boundaries
tasks.objective: Inspect the SQLite continuity store and its MCP continuity tool tests. Check transaction boundaries, task/project scoping, checkpoint integrity, retention/deletion behavior, and whether private stage output can escape bounded metadata responses. Make only scoped fixes with regression tests.
acceptance_criteria: The existing continuity implementation is inspected before any replacement is considered.
Private stage content remains inaccessible through bounded metadata/MCP responses.
Changes preserve project/task scope and have focused regression coverage.
No customer data or production memory database is read or modified.
